cards.d: If something is aesthetic, then it is concerned with a love of beauty.
cards.e: The dresses were noteworthy for their aesthetic design.

cards.d: If someone is arrogant, they think that they are more important than others.
cards.e: He is very arrogant. Even though he’s not the boss, he tells everyone what to do.

cards.d: A bias is a person’s likelihood to like one thing more than another thing.
cards.e: The mothers had a natural bias for their own child’s picture.

cards.d: A canyon is a narrow valley with steep walls through which a river often flows.
cards.e: The canyon was so deep that the ground inside was covered in shadow.

cards.d: A creek is a stream or small river.
cards.e: Only small fish lived in the shallow waters of the creek.

cards.d: A drill is a tool with a point that spins in order to make a hole.
cards.e: The carpenter used the drill to make several holes in the wood.

cards.d: An executive is the top manager of a business.
cards.e: After twenty years at the company, he finally became the executive.

cards.d: Fatigue is a feeling of extreme tiredness.
cards.e: After three days with little sleep, she was feeling a lot of fatigue.

cards.d: An incline is a sharp rise in something, especially a hill or mountain.
cards.e: This mountain has one of the steepest inclines in the world.

cards.d: If something is nasty, then it is not nice or pleasant.
cards.e: The rotten apple left a nasty taste inside her mouth.

cards.d: To perceive something means to be aware of it.
cards.e: He was talking loudly, so he did not perceive that the music had stopped.

cards.d: A primate is a type of mammal that includes monkeys, apes, and humans.
cards.e: Primates use their hands for such tasks as swinging from branches.

cards.d: If something is primitive, then it is simple, basic, and not very developed.
cards.e: The computers of the 1980s are primitive compared to those of today.

cards.d: A stereotype is a general but often incorrect idea about a person or thing.
cards.e: There’s a stereotype that pigs are dirty animals. But they are rather clean.

cards.d: If something is sticky, then it is covered with a substance that things stick to.
cards.e: Place the sticky part of the tape against the paper, so it will cling to the wall.

cards.d: A termite is an insect that lives in groups and feeds on wood.
cards.e: The wood we found was full of termites.

cards.d: If something happens thereby an action, then it is the result of that action.
cards.e: He didn’t score a goal, thereby ending his chance at setting a record.

cards.d: A trail is a path through a wild area.
cards.e: A narrow trail cut through the field and over the hills.

cards.d: A twig is a short and thin branch from a tree or bush.
cards.e: They started the fire with a handful of dry twigs.

cards.d: Welfare is the health and happiness of a person or group.
cards.e: Having plenty of clean water is necessary for the welfare of people.
